_comment: Copy to plans.json and fill in your own values — plans.json is gitignored because the accounts map holds real login addresses. Flat-rate subscriptions have NO per-call cost, so their per-project figures are ALLOCATED (fee split by token share within the billing period), never measured. 'plans' entries are TEMPLATES, one per plan family — the actual subscriptions are (family x account) pairs discovered from the data, so adding or cancelling an account needs no code change. 'accounts' only carries per-account overrides; an account with no entry bills at its family's default fee and is flagged in the UI.

accounts._comment: Keyed by the address each CLI is signed in as. Per-account overrides, all optional: label, monthly_usd, cycle_day, active_from, active_to. active_to: 'auto' means the subscription was cancelled on an unknown date — it is inferred from the account's last usage and shown as inferred (trailing '?') rather than guessed silently.

hosts._comment: Optional display names. Any host not listed uses its reported hostname, uppercased.

roots._comment: Path roots used for project/repo attribution. First segment under a root = project; second = repo; '<project>/worktrees/<repo>--<branch>' resolves back to <repo>. Anything outside every root is attributed to 'ad-hoc'.
